notes.title: Patch 1.2
notes.notes:
• Adjusted volume of some SFX that were too loud
• Fixed a bug that prevented some enemies from losing Stunned status.
• Fixed a bug that allowed some enemies to walk through obstacles erroneously.
• Fixed a bug that prevented you from Distracting Stunned enemies.

notes.title: Patch 1.1
notes.notes:
• Fixed a bug that prevented a sound effect being played for the "Remove object" component effect.
• Added additional enemy spawn points in levels.
• Adjusted the pacing for progression by changing the time at which some components are unlocked.
• Fixed a bug that caused some objects in the level to move inadvertently after being revived by Smelling Salts.

notes.title: Upcoming Release on April 7!
notes.notes:
Exciting news! Scarred Mansion will release on Steam in four (4) days, on April 7, 2025!

After five years of development, it is great to have a release date on the horizon.

Thank you for the support and for wishlisting the game, and we hope to see you in a few days.
